title: 180. Online Stock Span

examples.explanation: Each span counts consecutive days backwards with price less than or equal to today: day 4 (70) covers 60 and 70 for a span of 2; day 6 (75) covers 60, 70, 60, 75 for 4; day 7 (85) covers all except 100 for 6.
Spans are computed streaming: 5 covers 4 and 5, 90 covers all before it, 120 covers all before it, and 80 covers only itself.
Strictly decreasing prices each have a span of 1.

hints: Keep a monotonic decreasing stack of (price, span) pairs.
For each price, accumulate spans while the stack top price is less than or equal to the current price, then push the combined span.
